questions.question: Which Cypher command would you use to load data from a CSV file?
In a complex data import scenario involving both nodes and relationships, which of the following sequence of steps is recommended?
options: Import nodes and relationships in separate transactions.

questions.question: Which of the following statements applies when using the LOAD CSV statement?
options: All values are cast as a string.
You must cast any values other than a string using the appropriate Cypher function.
You must define the data types for each file in import.conf.
The database will automatically determine the data type when reading the CSV file.

questions.question: If you omit WITH HEADERS from a LOAD CSV statement, which of the following will happen?
options: Each row will be treated as a list.
An LLM will generate headers for you.
The statement will lead to a Syntax Error.

questions.question: What is the best method for importing data to Neo4j?
options: Depends on the data source and system requirements (online, offline, etc.).

questions.question:
Complete the following Cypher statement to instruct Neo4j that the first row in the CSV file contains headers.

LOAD CSV -- select -- FROM 'file:///people.csv' AS row
CREATE (p:Person)
SET p += row
